name: feature-engine-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is feature_engine (Feature-engine), a Python library of scikit-learn
compatible transformers that engineer and select features in pandas DataFrames: encoders, imputers,
discretisers, outlier handlers, variable transformations, feature creation and selection.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the encoding subsystem of feature_engine: every module under feature_engine/encoding/ and feature_engine/variable_handling/, the shared modules they build on (feature_engine/__init__.py, feature_engine/dataframe_checks.py, feature_engine/tags.py, feature_engine/_base_transformers/mixins.py, every module under feature_engine/_check_init_parameters/, and the feature_engine/_docstrings/ package except its selection/ subpackage), together with the pages README.md, docs/index.rst and every page under docs/user_guide/encoding/, docs/api_doc/encoding/, docs/user_guide/variable_handling/ and docs/api_doc/variable_handling/, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
